subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting, or should user-dimensional billing/quota reporting remain plugin/external for now?
rationale: Current source has session origin metadata and operator-scoped usage APIs, but no canonical user identity, retention, aggregation, or authorization contract for billing-grade per-user views.

options.title: Define core accounting subject first
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved subject model and authorization rules before implementing per-user usage in core RPCs/UI.

options.title: Keep it plugin/external for now
options.body: Document current usage exports and leave multi-user billing/quota reporting to external tooling until core has a broader multi-user product direction.

options.title: Narrow to session/channel reporting
options.body: Improve existing session, agent, and channel usage visibility without promising per-user billing semantics.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved subject model and authorization rules before implementing per-user usage in core RPCs/UI.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-history owner for the usage RPC, cost-summary, and Dashboard usage surfaces that need the product/security decision.
